description: Rajamangala University of Technology Thanyaburi publishes RAW-Q, water-quality observations and reconstructed records for six Chao Phraya River stations in Thailand. Six CSV files contain 211,322 data points from June 2022 through February 2023, including turbidity, oxygen, conductivity, pH, dissolved solids, salinity, temperature, chlorophyll and depth. IEEE DataPort identifies the dataset, and registry metadata grants CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. The regional series can calibrate water-quality simulations or benchmark forecasting used in supply monitoring. Reconstructed and filtered records should not be treated as uninterrupted raw sensor output, and coverage is limited to the study stations and period. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Raw Water Quality Dataset Thailand
notes: G4-0371; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
